purpose: The diagnosis AI must tag every problem with exactly one of these types. Plain code then maps the type to what it justifies. AI never picks services.

evidenceKinds.public: Can be proven from saved public evidence (quotes from pages, screenshots)
evidenceKinds.absence_check: Based on something missing — needs a recorded check (what was checked, where, when, screenshot)
evidenceKinds.client_data: Needs client-provided data, review/comment quotes, or your confirmation — a website crawl alone cannot prove it

types.labelAr: العروض غير واضحة أو غير منظمة
types.definition: Products/services/packages are not clearly listed, grouped or explained.
Prices differ across channels or are missing/unclear.

types.labelAr: لا يوجد منتج أو عرض رئيسي واضح
types.definition: No prioritised flagship or entry offer the brand leads with.
Visual or verbal identity differs across website, social and ads.
No clear reason for the customer to choose this brand over others.
Client data shows weak retention or repeat purchase.

types.labelAr: لا توجد رحلة ما بعد الشراء
types.definition: No loyalty, referral or after-sale journey exists.
Reviews or comments show repeated after-sale complaints.
Channels are active without a defined audience, objective or priorities.
The brand invests in channels that do not match where its market is.

types.labelAr: نشر غير منتظم على السوشيال ميديا
types.definition: Posting gaps, no cadence, no content plan visible.

types.labelAr: محتوى ضعيف أو غير متوافق مع البراند
types.definition: Content is low quality, off-brand or limited to one format.
No professional product/service photography or video.
Visible unanswered comments, questions or messages.

types.labelEn: Website missing or not working well
types.labelAr: الموقع غير موجود أو لا يعمل جيدًا
types.definition: No website, broken pages, or not usable on mobile.

types.labelEn: Unclear path to buy or contact
types.labelAr: مسار الشراء أو التواصل غير واضح
types.definition: No clear call to action, form, checkout or WhatsApp path.
The brand is not found for its name or category searches.

types.labelEn: No or weak Google Ads despite search demand
types.labelAr: غياب أو ضعف إعلانات Google رغم وجود بحث
types.definition: Customers search for the category but the brand has no effective search ads.
No active or effective Facebook/Instagram ads (Meta Ad Library check).

types.labelEn: No or weak TikTok ads for a TikTok audience
types.labelAr: غياب أو ضعف إعلانات TikTok لجمهور موجود هناك
types.definition: The audience is on TikTok but the brand runs no effective ads there.

types.labelAr: لا يوجد جمع أو متابعة لقائمة العملاء
types.definition: No email capture or nurture of existing and potential customers.
Meeting notes or evidence show slow, manual handling of leads and follow-ups.
Few or no creator mentions in a category where buyers rely on creators.
No analytics or ad pixel detected. Blocks ads execution until fixed; justifies no service by itself.

types.labelEn: Real problem with no matching catalog service
types.labelAr: مشكلة حقيقية بدون خدمة مناسبة في الكتالوج
types.definition: Kept in the internal record and shown to you; never generates a service.
